# 1 Enoch Chapter 62 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** The Lord issued a command to the kings and the powerful and the arrogant and all who rule on earth: "Open your eyes and lift your heads — if you have the ability to recognize the Elect One."

**2** The Lord of Spirits seated him on the throne of his glory. The spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him. The word from his mouth destroys every sinner, and all the unrighteous are wiped out before his face.

**3** On that day all the kings will rise — the powerful, the arrogant, all who control the earth. They will see and understand how he sits on the throne of his glory, and how righteousness is adjudicated before him, and how not one lying word is permitted in his presence.

**4** Then anguish will strike them — the anguish of a woman in the agony of labor, when her child is about to be born, seized with birth-pangs.

**5** They will stare at one another, paralyzed with terror, their faces fallen and their hearts gripped with pain — all because they see that Son of Man sitting on the throne of his glory.

**6** The kings and the mighty and all who control the earth will then bless and glorify and exalt him who has ruled over everything all along — the one who was hidden.

**7** For from the very beginning, the Son of Man was hidden. The Most High kept him in his own presence, in the shelter of his power, and revealed him only to the elect.

**8** The community of the elect and holy will be gathered like seed, and all the elect will stand before him on that day.

**9** All the kings, the powerful, the arrogant, all the rulers of the earth will throw themselves face-down before him, worship him, and put all their hope in that Son of Man. They will plead with him and beg for mercy from his hands.

**10** But the Lord of Spirits will press them so hard that they will flee from his presence in haste. Their faces will burn with shame, and darkness will settle ever deeper over them.

**11** He will hand them over to the punishment-angels, to carry out vengeance against them — because they abused his children and his elect.

**12** They will become a spectacle for the righteous and for his elect. The righteous will celebrate over them, because the wrath of the Lord of Spirits is resting on them and his sword has drunk deep of their blood.

**13** The righteous and elect will be delivered on that day, and from that moment on they will never again have to look at the faces of sinners and the unrighteous.

**14** The Lord of Spirits will dwell over them, and with that Son of Man they will eat together, and lie down together, and rise up together — forever and ever.

**15** The righteous and elect will have risen up from the earth, their faces no longer fallen with grief. They will have been dressed in garments of glory —

**16** garments of life, given by the Lord of Spirits. And these garments will never wear out, and their glory will never fade before the Lord of Spirits.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Ch. 62 is the theological climax of the entire Parables. Four key interpretive decisions: (1) 'that Son of Man' — preserved with the definite article, which is crucial; it points back to ch. 46's first introduction; (2) 'from the beginning hidden' — the pre-existence language is rendered as clearly as possible; (3) 'spectacle' — preserved, not softened; this is a pointed reversal of Roman spectacle culture; (4) 'eat and lie down and rise up with the Son of Man forever' — the eschatological communion meal is central.*
